standard_prerequisites.name: Numerical types, their five defining conditions and the minus-one index
standard_prerequisites.statement: A numerical type is a tuple of an integer n and integer families of multiplicities, intersection numbers, weights and genera subject to five conditions: positivity of multiplicities, weights and genera; symmetry of the intersection matrix with nonnegative off-diagonal entries; no proper nonempty subset of indices that fails to interact with its complement; vanishing of each weighted row sum; and divisibility of every intersection number by the corresponding weight. An index is a minus-one index when its genus is zero and its self-intersection equals the negative of its weight. The author's own definition and the two lemmas of the same chapter that the proof quotes are the allowed inputs.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma is the contraction step on which the whole section on the Picard group of a numerical type rests: it produces a smaller type of the same genus whenever a minus-one index is present.

core_obligations: Check that the number of vertices of the contracted data is at least one: the type is not irreducible when it carries a minus-one index, which the author reads off from the chapter's lemma on irreducible types, and the neighbouring lemma on nonpositive diagonal entries is quoted for the same step (source lines 798-799).

Verify the five defining conditions of a numerical type for the contracted data with the stated multiplicities, intersection numbers, weights and genera: positivity, symmetry with nonnegative off-diagonal entries, the absence of a subset failing to interact with its complement, the vanishing weighted row sums, and the divisibility of the intersection numbers by the weights (source lines 800-855).

Compute the genus of the contracted type from the displayed formula for the new genera and show that it equals the genus of the original type, which is the moreover clause of the statement (source lines 855-859).

proof_roadmap.step: Show the contracted type has at least one vertex, using the lemma on irreducible types.
Verify the five defining conditions one by one for the contracted data.
Compute the genus of the contracted type and check it equals the original genus.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 Stacks Project 章 models.tex 的 Lemma lemma-contract（源 780-795 行，证明 797-859 行，63 行）：若数值类型 T 的某 index 是 (−1)-index，则按五条显式公式（n′=n−1、m′_i=m_i、a′_ij=a_ij−a_in a_jn/a_nn、w′_i 按奇偶性取 w_i/2 或 w_i、g′_i=(w_i/w′_i)(g_i−1)+1+(a_in²−w_n a_in)/(2w′_i w_n)）构造出新的数值类型 T′，且亏格不变。关键操作不是例行核验：证明必须**逐条核对定义中的五个条件**（正性、对称且非对角非负、无割集、加权行和为零、w_i|a_ij），其中加权行和为零与整除性都要用到 a′_ij 的消元式与 w′_i 的奇偶分支（800-855 行），最后还要把 g′ 的公式代入亏格定义算出 g′=g（855-859 行）；开头还须先用本章「不可约类型的 index 必为 (−1)-index 之外」的结果排除 n′=0（798-799 行）。难点在于奇偶分支（w′_i=w_i/2）与整除性、行和恒等式三者必须同时成立；原文位置在证明的 798-799、800-855、855-859 行。
